description: NSF award search — Search National Science Foundation awards by topic q= (multi-word queries are matched as a phrase), awardee institution org=, investigator pi=, awardee state= and award date since=YYYY-MM-DD. Returns total matches and up to 25 awards (id, title, awardee, city/state, PI, program, directorate/division, obligated and estimated total dollars, award/start/end dates, active flag, abstract excerpt, NSF link) plus aggregates over the sample: top programs, top awardees and top directorates by obligated dollars. limit= 1-25 (default 10). Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: research_nsf_awards
